Endgame - a b0b.dev film

Endgame is one word. τετέλεσται, tetelestai: “It is finished” (John 19:30). A perfect passive: not “it ended”, but it has been completed, and remains so.

Download the film (MP4, 1280×720, subtitles burned in).

The script

  1. I. It is finished — When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost. (John 19:30)
  2. II. Tetelestai — Tetelestai. It is finished. Not “it ended”, but: it has been completed, and remains so.
